Lovevery and Our Place have teamed up on a limited edition of The Real Life Kitchen, bringing even more pretend play into your everyday life.\
\
Featuring an exclusive colorway and brand-new accessories inspired by Our Place, Lovevery’s kitchen invites little chefs to pretend to cook. It comes with the brand new Pretend Play Cook Set, including a silicone burner and a play version of Our Place’s iconic Always Pan, lid, and spatula. Because sometimes the best seat at the table is the one where they get to play along. 🥣\
\
And now it’s your turn to cook and play! 🥣 3 lucky families will win the ultimate kitchen pairing: The Real Life Play Kitchen, complete with the Lovevery x Our Place Pretend Play Cook Set, plus an Our Place Signature Ceramic Always Pan Duo in Blue Salt for the grown-ups! \
\
To enter:\
- Like this post ❤️\
- Follow @OurPlace and @Lovevery on Instagram.\
- Tag someone in the comments who would love this collab!\
- Bonus entry: Share this post to your story.\
\
Now for the important question: What’s the first thing your little chef is putting on the menu? 👇👩‍🍳\
\
Giveaway ends at 11:59PM PST on 10\/29\/26. To enter, you must be at least 18 years old and an individual resident of and located in the contiguous U.S. 3 winners will be randomly selected and notified by 11\/06\/2026 by Lovevery.
